title: Match category no-credit fixtures to the launcher's recorded Vitest argv
outcome: The category-credit regression test represents actual terminal Vitest argv, and comments accurately state whether category scope or stage rules enforce no credit.
acceptance: A behavioral category record test includes the launcher-owned vitest-json reporter and --outputFile.json suffix and proves the intended unclassified no-credit outcome.
The no-credit guard and comments accurately cover actual category argv and any client-stage-list fallback they claim to exclude, with no test reading source or Markdown text.
